items.where: plinth of black glazed brick along the whole street front (2.3 m on the bath wing and corner house, 1.45 m on the east house), the gate block entirely in black glazed brick
items.how: dark slabs 6 cm proud of the drawn brick fronts; the gate block as dark sections

items.where: round-arched gate in the black gate block with an iron grille and a ring of glazed headers, a Star of David on the pantiles above
items.how: round-headed cut opening 0.7 m deep with nine thin grille bars and a rail, a dark arch ring; the star as two gold triangles (poly) on the roof skirt

items.where: bath wing: eight small square two-light windows sitting on the plinth; corner house: four-light green timber bay over a white-framed door; east house: white-framed two- and three-light windows; gate block: a four-light window
items.how: street-front-kit cut openings with green or white frames and glazing bars; the timber bay as a green box with framed lights

items.where: cream eaves boards at 2.6, 3.45, 4.2, 6.45 and 7.0 m under red pantile roofs
items.how: cream slabs 32-38 cm proud; pantile skirts (TriSink quads) from the board up to the 3DBAG eaves line where the drawn storey is lower than the 3DBAG wall

items.where: three dormers in the east house roof with white-framed windows
items.how: brick boxes in the roof skirt with a white frame, glass and a pantile cap; the cheeks are brick, not tile

items.where: oval stone cartouche between the east house first-floor windows
items.how: stone slab with a brick inset (the carving is not drawn)
